verdict.rationale: A company registry with a public API and a 'Follow companies' feature could plausibly offer scheduled or background automations, so the axis applies. The pack documents no automation, scheduling or recurring-job capability. The REST GET API is only a developer building block a user could script against, and 'Follow companies' and 'Get emails' are adjacent notification features, not user-configured autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
